drivingQuestion: Does the buyer acquire when the son sold and died before the father?
outcomeNote: The case is stated; the rulings follow in the next unit.

segments.he: הַכּוֹתֵב נְכָסָיו לִבְנוֹ לְאַחַר מוֹתוֹ. אִיתְּמַר: מָכַר הַבֵּן בְּחַיֵּי הָאָב, וּמֵת הַבֵּן בְּחַיֵּי הָאָב –
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if «one writes» a document granting «his property to his son» from today and «after his death,» neither he nor the son can sell the property. It «was stated» that in a case where «the son sold» the property «during the father’s lifetime, and» then «the son died during the father’s lifetime,» after which the father died as well,

moves.summary: case: the son sold and died in the father's lifetime
